```{r}
#| echo: false
library(tidyverse)
library(openintro)
library(maps)

```


```{r}
#| echo: false
# 1. Load libraries and copy data
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggspatial)

my_data <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dem04747/data/main/hydra_tiny.csv")
```



```{r}
my_data <- my_data %>%
  mutate(
    lat2 = as.numeric(lat2),
    long2 = as.numeric(long2)
  )
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

my_data <- my_data %>%
  mutate(
    lat2 = parse_number(as.character(lat2)),
    long2 = parse_number(as.character(long2))
  )
```


```{r}
# Convert coordinates to sf object using your actual column names (longitude first, then latitude)
hydra_sf <- my_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(lat2), !is.na(long2)) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("long2", "lat2"), crs = 4326)

ggplot() +
  annotation_map_tile(type = "osm", zoom = 9) + 
  geom_sf(data = hydra_sf, color = "red", size = 1, alpha = 0.6) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Hydra Locations")
```



```{r}
hydra_sf <- my_data %>%
  mutate(
    lat2 = parse_number(as.character(lat2)),
    long2 = parse_number(as.character(long2))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(lat2), !is.na(long2), lat2 != 0, long2 != 0) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("long2", "lat2"), crs = 4326)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# Check rows where lat2 became NA after coercion
bad_rows <- my_data %>%
  mutate(lat2_num = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(lat2))) %>%
  filter(is.na(lat2_num) & !is.na(lat2))

# View those rows to see what text is hiding in the column
print(bad_rows)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| eval: false
ggplot(data = hydra_sf) +
  geom_sf(color = "red", size = 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Hydra Locations")
```
